# Dates and deadlines (DAT)

The dates an invoice carries and the deadlines for issuing it, sending it and charging its VAT.

Rules page: https://docs.beel.es/rules/dates

"Checked by: Your integration" or "The issuing business" means BeeL. does not enforce the rule, beyond any error codes it lists: the integration has to.

## DAT-001

**Do not send an issue date**

`MUST NOT` · BeeL. rule · Impact: critical · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

The API has no writable issue date: an invoice is dated the day it is issued, and a scheduled one the day it is scheduled for. To record when the sale happened, send operation_date.

**Why:** Backdating or postdating an invoice is not possible: the issue date is the day its billing record is generated. An integration that tries to set it ends up with invoices dated differently from what it expects.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `issueCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Incorrect:** Trying to send an issue date set to the last day of the previous month to close the month's invoicing.

**Correct:** Issuing today, with the date the service was provided as operation_date.

```json
{ "operation_date": "2026-08-31", "lines": [{ "description": "August maintenance", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 300 }] }
```

**Related:** DAT-002, DAT-004, LIF-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#dates

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-001.md

## DAT-002

**The issue date is the day the billing record is generated**

`MUST` · AEAT criterion · Impact: high · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. does this for you.

An invoice's issue date is the date its billing record is generated, which is also, as a rule, the day the record is sent: it cannot be later than today nor set to an earlier day. BeeL. dates the invoice when you issue it.

**Why:** An issue date that does not match the record's makes the record inconsistent; AEAT rejects an issue date in the future.

**Applies to:** statuses `ISSUED`; Invoices under VeriFactu.

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU, Sistemas VERI*FACTU — https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es/Sede/iva/sistemas-informaticos-facturacion-verifactu/preguntas-frecuentes/sistemas-verifactu.html
- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.1 Agrupación IDFactura — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf
- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), art. 9 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#a9

**Incorrect:** Keeping a month of invoices as drafts and expecting them to carry the dates of each sale when you issue them at month end.

**Correct:** Issuing each invoice when the sale happens, or issuing later with each sale's date as operation_date and within the deadlines.

**Related:** DAT-001, DAT-006, REC-002

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu/what-aeat-receives#dates-and-late-submission · https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#dates

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-002.md

## DAT-003

**The operation date is never after the issue date**

`MUST NOT` · AEAT criterion · Impact: medium · Checked by: BeeL. API. BeeL. rejects a request that breaks it.

operation_date is the day the operation took place or the advance payment was received, so it cannot be later than the issue date. To bill before delivering, invoice the advance payment with the day you received it.

**Why:** AEAT does not accept an operation dated in the future except in two special regimes; an invoice dated before the operation it documents is not consistent.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Error codes:** [`OPERATION_DATE_AFTER_ISSUE_DATE`](https://docs.beel.es/errors/OPERATION_DATE_AFTER_ISSUE_DATE)

**Legal basis:**

- AEAT, Validaciones y errores VERI*FACTU (v1.2.2), 3.1.3.7 FechaOperacion — https://www.agenciatributaria.es/static_files/AEAT_Desarrolladores/EEDD/IVA/VERI-FACTU/Validaciones_Errores_Veri-Factu.pdf

**Incorrect:** Issuing today an invoice for next week's delivery with that date as operation_date: the API answers OPERATION_DATE_AFTER_ISSUE_DATE.

**Correct:** Issuing the invoice on the delivery day, or invoicing now the advance payment you already received.

**Related:** DAT-004, DAT-010

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#dates

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-003.md

## DAT-004

**Send the operation date when it differs from the issue date**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: high · Checked by: Your integration. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the goods were delivered, the service provided or the advance received on a day other than the issue date, send that day as operation_date. Omitted, the invoice takes the issue date as the operation date.

**Why:** The operation date decides the VAT rate and the tax period. Without it, an invoice issued in October for a September sale says the sale happened in October.

**Applies to:** operations `createCompanyInvoice`, `patchCompanyInvoice`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 6.1.i) — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a6

**Incorrect:** Issuing on 2 October the invoice for work finished on 30 September without operation_date.

**Correct:** Sending the day the work was finished.

```json
{ "operation_date": "2026-09-30", "lines": [{ "description": "Website redesign", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 2400 }] }
```

**Related:** DAT-001, DAT-003, TAX-001

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/invoice-lifecycle#dates

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-004.md

## DAT-005

**Invoice consumers when the operation takes place**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the customer is a consumer, issue the invoice at the moment the operation is performed.

**Why:** An invoice to a consumer issued days later breaks the issuing deadline, and under VeriFactu its record reaches AEAT late too.

**Applies to:** Operations with a recipient that is not a business or professional acting as such.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 11.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a11

**Incorrect:** An online shop collects the day's orders and issues their invoices the following week.

**Correct:** The shop issues each invoice when the order is completed.

**Related:** DAT-006, DAT-002

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-005.md

---

## DAT-006

**Invoice businesses before day 16 of the following month**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

When the customer is a business or professional, issue the invoice before day 16 of the month after the one in which the VAT accrued.

**Why:** An invoice issued after the deadline breaches the invoicing obligations and can be sanctioned, even though the sale was declared.

**Applies to:** Operations with a business or professional acting as such.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 11.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a11

**Incorrect:** Invoicing on 20 October a service to a company that was completed on 25 September.

**Correct:** Issuing that invoice by 15 October, with operation_date set to 25 September.

**Related:** DAT-005, DAT-007, DAT-008

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-006.md

---

## DAT-007

**One invoice for a month of operations, issued in time**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

You may put several operations for the same customer in one invoice only if they all took place in the same calendar month. Issue it by the last day of that month or, when the customer is a business, before day 16 of the next one.

**Why:** Grouping operations from different months in one invoice, or issuing it late, breaches the invoicing rules even when every operation is on it.

**Applies to:** Recapitulative invoices: several operations for the same customer in one invoice.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 13.1 y 13.2 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a13

**Incorrect:** One invoice to a company for deliveries made between 20 August and 10 September.

**Correct:** One invoice for the August deliveries and another for the September ones, each issued in time.

**Related:** DAT-006, DAT-004

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-007.md

## DAT-008

**Deliver the invoice to the customer in time**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Send the original invoice to the customer when you issue it or, when the customer is a business, before day 16 of the month after the accrual. BeeL. can email it, but does not track the deadline.

**Why:** An invoice the customer never receives cannot be deducted by them, and delivering it is an obligation of the issuer.

**Applies to:** statuses `ISSUED`; operations `sendCompanyInvoice`, `createCompanyInvoiceDelivery`

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 18 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a18

**Incorrect:** Issuing invoices through the API and never delivering them, assuming AEAT's record reaches the customer.

**Correct:** Emailing the PDF from BeeL. once it is ready, or delivering it through your own channel.

**Related:** DAT-006, CNT-018

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/guides/sending-email

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-008.md

## DAT-009

**VAT is charged by invoice within 1 year of accrual**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

VAT is passed on to the customer through an invoice, and the right to charge it is lost 1 year after the VAT accrued.

**Why:** Invoicing or correcting upwards after that window leaves the issuer paying a VAT it can no longer charge to the customer.

**Applies to:** Every operation that accrues VAT.

**Legal basis:**

- Ley 37/1992 del IVA, art. 88.Cuatro — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1992-28740#a88

**Incorrect:** Finding in 2027 a service delivered in March 2025 that was never invoiced, and invoicing it with VAT.

**Correct:** Reconciling unbilled operations every month, so each is invoiced within the deadlines.

**Related:** DAT-006, COR-006

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-009.md

## DAT-010

**Invoice advance payments when you receive them**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

A payment received before the operation is invoiced too, with the day you received it as operation_date; the final invoice then covers the rest. Exempt intra-EU supplies of goods are the exception.

**Why:** VAT accrues when an advance is received, so an advance without its invoice leaves VAT accrued and never charged.

**Applies to:** Payments received before the goods are delivered or the service is provided.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 2.1, párrafo segundo — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a2

**Incorrect:** Collecting a 30 % deposit on a kitchen installation and invoicing everything only when the work is finished.

**Correct:** Invoicing the deposit the day it is received, and the remaining 70 % when the installation is completed.

**Related:** DAT-003, DAT-004

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-010.md

## DAT-011

**Adapted billing systems are mandatory from 1 January 2027 or 1 July 2027**

`MUST` · Law · Impact: medium · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Corporate-tax payers must invoice with a billing system adapted to the regulation before 1 January 2027, and the other taxpayers it covers before 1 July 2027. Which group you are in, and whether the regulation applies to you, is yours to determine.

**Why:** Invoicing after the deadline with a system that does not meet the regulation is an infringement of the taxpayer, not of the software.

**Applies to:** Taxpayers under the billing-systems regulation; those keeping their VAT books through the SII are outside it.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1007/2023 (RRSIF), disposición final cuarta — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2023-24840#df-4

**Incorrect:** A company subject to corporate tax plans its switch to an adapted billing system for spring 2027.

**Correct:** The company enables VeriFactu and tests its integration in the sandbox during 2026.

**Related:** REC-001, LIF-003

**Explained in:** https://docs.beel.es/verifactu#at-a-glance

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-011.md

## DAT-012

**Plan for mandatory B2B electronic invoices**

`SHOULD` · Law · Impact: low · Checked by: The issuing business. BeeL. does not check this; you must.

Once the ministerial order that RD 238/2026 depends on is in force, businesses will have to issue structured electronic invoices to other Spanish businesses, first the largest ones and later the rest. Until that order is published the obligation does not apply; watch for it.

**Why:** The deadline starts counting from an order that has not been published yet, and adapting invoicing to structured formats takes time.

**Applies to:** Invoices to businesses and professionals established in Spain, once RD 238/2026 applies.

**Legal basis:**

- RD 1619/2012 (Reglamento de facturación), art. 8 bis.1 — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2012-14696#a8bis
- RD 238/2026, disposición final cuarta — https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2026-7295#df-4

**Incorrect:** Assuming a PDF sent by email will keep being enough for every business customer indefinitely.

**Correct:** Tracking the publication of the ministerial order and planning a structured format for invoices to Spanish businesses.

**Related:** CNT-018, QRC-010

**Full rule, with the legal text quoted:** https://docs.beel.es/rules/DAT-012.md
